Kelimeyi değil rengini seç! 60 saniyede: Pick the color, not the word! A free color game that tests your reflexes and focus in 60 seconds. Three difficulties, a daily challenge and leaderboards
Ekranın ortasında bir renk adı belirir,: A color name appears in the middle of the screen, but it's usually written in a different color. For example, if you see the word "BLUE" written in red, the right answer is Red. Don't read the word; look at the color of the letters and pick that color from the buttons below. Each correct answer is worth 10 points; after more than five in a row each one is worth 15, and after more than ten, 20. A wrong answer resets your streak and costs two seconds. A quick game lasts 60 seconds; when time's up you see your score, accuracy and average reaction time
Kolay seviyede 4 renk vardır ve düğmeler: Easy has 4 colors, and the buttons show a colored dot. Normal has 6 colors, and the buttons only show the color name in white. On Hard the button labels are tricky too: a button that says "GREEN" may be purple, and you go by the button's name. The buttons shuffle every five questions, and on some rounds the rule flips: when a purple "WORD" label appears at the top, you pick the word's meaning instead of the text color
Bilgisayarda 1-6 rakam tuşları düğmeleri: On a computer, number keys 1-6 pick the buttons from left to right, top to bottom. You can also use the Turkish initials: K red, M blue, Y green, S yellow, T orange. Since P pauses the game, purple can only be picked with a number key. When the game ends, Space starts a new round. On a phone, just tap the buttons
Beynimiz okumayı otomatik yapar, bu yüzd: Your brain reads automatically, so focusing on the word slows you down. Try locking your eyes on the color of one letter in the middle instead of the whole word. Rushing into a mistake costs two seconds, so find your rhythm in the first few seconds, then speed up. If you play on a keyboard, keep your fingers on the 1-6 number keys. On Hard, check the label at the top first on every new question: is it "COLOR" or "WORD"
<strong>Bu oyun neyi ölçer?</strong> Seç: What does this game measure? Selective attention and reaction speed, using the effect known in psychology as the color-word interference test. I'm color-blind, can I play? Yes, the Patterns option in the game menu adds a shape to every color and your choice is saved. What changes in daily mode? Everyone gets the same set of questions on Normal that day, so scores can be compared.
